messages:
Ria (UX): quick note from testing: users want less noisy run history. proposing a per-invocation 'Compact' affordance that collapses verbose tool outputs into a single-line summary. thoughts? Marco (Frontend): yup. prefer per-invocation start, with "apply to all" in toolbar for power users. Anya (Eng-ML): engineering constraints: some outputs are huge (logs/binary). we must not render them into the DOM when compacted. suggestion: store a lightweight summary in metadata and fetch full payload on expand. Tess (Design): a11y nits: control needs an explicit label (not just icon), aria-expanded toggles, keyboard focus ring, and clear tooltip. microcopy: 'Show condensed output'. Owen (PM): metrics to capture: compact_toggled, compact_expand, compact_collapse, compact_apply_all. want expand latency <300ms. also track if users re-open full output after seeing summary. Ria (UX): inline mock (small):```html
{summary} 2 lines collapsed
``` Marco (Frontend): front-end plan: persist per-user pref in localStorage, expose workspace default later. will implement minimal UI + mocked fetch first. estimate 2.5d frontend + 1d QA. Anya (Eng-ML): backend: add GET /invokes/:id/full that runs standard sanitization (PII redaction) before returning. support streaming for big payloads. also include a tiny validation summary (ok/warn/error) in invocation metadata. Tess (Design): microcopy tweak: tooltip 'Preserves full output; click to reveal.' show a small 'schema mismatch' badge inline (red) when applicable. Ria (UX): UX detail: when expanded then re-collapsed, animate height to avoid content jump and keep focus on the invocation row. also show a one-time coach mark explaining token savings. Owen (PM): rollout: feature-flag gated, start with 5-10% of orgs. require accessibility sign-off before ramp. track support tickets tagged 'playground output truncated'. ops-bot: feature-flag created: compact-invokes -> staging. Marco (Frontend): quick a11y checklist for PR: aria-controls, aria-expanded, keyboard Enter/Space support, visible focus states, and screen-reader-friendly toast messages. Anya (Eng-ML): perf note: deferred fetch should respect ETag and caching to avoid repeated heavy fetches. ensure KV cache references are preserved for reruns. Tess (Design): color contrast check for chevron/badge and provide high-contrast variant. add aria-live region for streaming updates (polite). Ria (UX): next steps: Marco to open WIP PR with mocked endpoint; Tess will finalize copy and aria labels; Anya will provide backend contract; Owen will add analytics events to the ticket. I'll attach a short GIF when PR is up. :sparkles:
